name: files
description: Agent-first file management — index local folders and S3 buckets, sync Google Drive, tag, search, organize, and serve an evidence vault. CLI + MCP + HTTP API (files-serve) + generated SDK. Hosted clients resolve credential and authority through the @hasna/contracts 1.0.2 resolver (Keychain hasna.credentials.files.api-key, ~/.hasna/files/config/credentials, HASNA_FILES_API_KEY; default gateway https://api.hasna.com/files) fresh per request and fail closed with no credential; local SQLite is an explicit opt-in (HASNA_FILES_LOCAL=1). files-serve uses PostgreSQL when HASNA_FILES_DATABASE_URL is set, with API-key auth via @hasna/contracts; file bytes stay in S3.
